title: Abbreviated date
description: Replaces the spelled-out weekday and month with es-CR short forms — "Domingo, 23 de agosto" becomes "Dom 23 ago". Reads faster at a glance and takes noticeably less horizontal space next to the clock.

changes.intent: Abbreviate weekday and month so the date reads tighter and quieter beside the time.
changes.detail: Change the Intl.DateTimeFormat/toLocaleDateString options from { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' } to { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' } (locale 'es-CR'), still capitalized. 'Domingo, 23 de agosto' → 'Dom 23 ago' (drop the comma to match the tighter, list-style feel).

changes.intent: Slightly reduce letter-spacing/size now that the string is shorter, keeping proportion with the time.
